medium: Which product category has the highest gross margin per unit sold, and how does that compare to the category with the highest total revenue? Are they the same?
hard: Show month-over-month revenue growth for 2023, flagging any month where revenue dropped more than 10% vs the prior month. What was the channel mix each time we saw a drop?
Rank the top 10 customers by lifetime value. For each, break down their revenue by product category — which high-LTV customers are actually concentrated in just one category vs spread across many?
very_complex: Compare 2022 vs 2023 by region: which regions grew, which shrank, and for the growing regions, what share of growth came from new customers vs existing customers increasing their spend?

Find the 5 products with the biggest gap between units sold and revenue generated (i.e. high volume but low revenue contribution). What do these products have in common — are they all in the same category, same price tier, or sold mostly through one channel?
